sources.name: FEC Schedule E independent expenditures
sources.coverage: Federal candidate communications reported as independent expenditures, including sponsor, candidate, support or oppose direction, purpose, date, and amount.

sources.name: FCC public inspection political files
sources.coverage: Political time orders and related files uploaded by Nevada television, radio, cable, DBS, and satellite-radio entities.

sources.name: Nevada Secretary of State campaign-finance expenditures
sources.coverage: State and local campaign expenditures that identify advertising, media, mail, television, radio, digital, print, production, or related vendors.

sources.name: Meta Ad Library
sources.coverage: Political and social-issue ads delivered on Meta technologies with advertiser, creative, date, spend-range, impression-range, and regional delivery fields when available.

sources.name: Google Ads Transparency Center
sources.coverage: Verified advertiser and ad creative search across Google surfaces, filterable by region and date where available.

sources.name: Reviewed Nevada ad creative intake
sources.coverage: Campaign videos, public archive links, mailers, SMS captures, and other creative reviewed against a public source.
